method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: Reading and speaking time with set words-per-minute
features.detail: reading and speaking time, with the words-per-minute adjustable in settings
features.verse_evidence: Reading time at 238 wpm, speaking time at 183 wpm, fixed (lib/wordcount.js READ_WPM/SPEAK_WPM)

features.name: Keyword density panel (1, 2 and 3 word phrases)
features.detail: top keywords and phrases with counts and percentages; option to include common words
features.verse_evidence: single-word keyword density only (lib/wordcount.js keywords()); no 2/3-word phrases or "include common words" toggle

features.name: Activity / earlier versions
features.detail: go back to earlier saved versions of the document

features.name: Word / character goals
features.detail: set a target (e.g. 500 words) and be told when you reach it; goals shareable or embeddable

features.name: Settings: font size, display options
features.detail: adjust editor appearance and which panels show

features.name: Pages estimate
features.detail: how many pages the text fills (not confirmed by search)

features.name: Social media character limits
features.detail: how the text fits X, Facebook, etc. (seen on look-alike sites; unconfirmed on wordcounter.net)

verse_extra: Sentence counting that does not stop at Mr., U.S. or 3.5
Copy link that carries the text (?t=)
"Rehearse it": a countdown of its speaking time on /stopwatch/
gaps: Reading and speaking time with set words-per-minute
Keyword density panel (1, 2 and 3 word phrases)
